sheet: In temperament you are an ordinary person, close to the middle on everything. Your warmth, courtesy and trust in others are unremarkable. Your tidiness, work ethic and reliability are unremarkable. Your composure, and how often you worry or feel low, are unremarkable. Your sociability, assertiveness and energy are unremarkable. Your curiosity, imagination and openness to ideas are unremarkable. No single trait defines you.
appraisal: To you this is an ordinary week at work: a bit of pressure, nothing out of the way, and you are open to how the assistant turns out.
